These fixtures contain synthetic material only. They were generated on Node
24.22.1 from the existing writers at Archon BASE
bb5c9ce63d3720d87a323e18d7c03bf78cf42ae1, before those writers were extracted.
They are retained bytes, not generated by the new reader during tests.

- `writer.arcn`: original encryptStream, DEK `09` repeated 32 times, plaintext
  196627 bytes with byte i equal to i modulo 251 (three full frames and a tail).
- `writer.companion`: original encryptRecoveryMaterial, KEK `07` repeated 32
  times, installation/run/backup given in writer-reference.json. Synthetic P-256
  CA/leaf/TLS material was generated with openssl in a disposable temp directory.
- `writer-material.json`: original canonicalRecoveryJson output, including a
  non-ASCII path and UTF-8 file contents to pin Python-compatible fingerprints.
- `writer-reference.json`: full original writer reference plus synthetic locator.

Never use these keys, identities, certificates or payloads operationally.
